title: 698. Next Closest Time

examples.explanation: 39 is the next minute whose digits both appear in 19:34.
Wrapping past midnight, 22:22 is the earliest reachable time.
Only digit 0 is available, so the next valid time is the same.

hints: Collect the distinct digits appearing in the input.
Step forward minute by minute (wrapping after 23:59) and test whether every digit of the candidate belongs to the set.
